content.title: Message Relay | One Stable Carrier across Physical Media
content.summary: Keep one carrier traceable while related short messages advance through at least three media with visibly different material behavior. Make each handoff causal, change camera duty to prove each medium, and resolve the sequence in a new terminal medium rather than returning to the opening state.

quick_start.input_format: Stable carrier + relevant and progressive original short message sequence + at least three physical media + causal handover triggered by the carrier + lens proof of each media + new terminal media freeze-frame
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original Arctic surveying and mapping laboratory, a palm-high cobalt blue inspection vehicle drove into the light-colored ground grating. Four white tracks lit up in sequence and spelled out the exact English capital word SCAN under the vehicle; the paper tape entered the black ferrofluid table, the inspection vehicle pressed a cobalt blue contact, and five sets of fluid ridges rose to form the exact English capital word. NORTH, the magnetic peak and reflection are visible; the inspection vehicle is parked next to the glass panel under the light-colored skylight, the exact English capital word VERIFIED is clearly maintained in cyan frost, and the rear grating, paper tape and fluid station are identifiable as completed steps
required_anchors: Establish one stable carrier and the first concise original message state before the first medium change.
Advance a related sequence of short messages through at least three media with visibly different material behavior.
Change camera duty to prove each medium's physics while keeping the carrier or consequence traceable.
Resolve the final message state in a new terminal medium and hold it without returning to the opening state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Keep one carrier traceable while related short messages advance through at least three media with visibly different material behavior. Make each handoff causal, change camera duty to prove each medium, and resolve the sequence in a new terminal medium rather than returning to the opening state.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one stable carrier and the first concise readable message state, then advance a related sequence of short messages through at least three materially different physical or graphical media. Each new phrase must progress the informational state rather than repeat arbitrary slogans, every handoff must be motivated by carrier movement, contact or an explicit spatial transition, and each medium must demonstrate distinct physics rather than only a new font. Vary camera duty to prove those physics, preserve the carrier or its consequence, and finish on a clear terminal message in a new medium without returning to the opening state. Source wording, performer design and exact media order are not reusable.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable carrier and the first concise original message state before the first medium change.
invariants.purpose: Defines the identity and informational starting point of the relay.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a stable carrier and initial message state, later scenes become unrelated typography shots.

invariants.rule: Advance a related sequence of short messages through at least three media with visibly different material behavior.
invariants.purpose: Proves a coherent informational progression and cross-medium continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one word without progression, or swapping only color and font, does not form the observed evolving-message relay.

invariants.rule: Make each handoff causal through carrier movement, contact or a readable spatial boundary.
invariants.purpose: Connects the media changes into one forward process.
invariants.ablation_failure: Arbitrary montage cuts remove the sense of transfer.

invariants.rule: Change camera duty to prove each medium's physics while keeping the carrier or consequence traceable.
invariants.purpose: Makes material differences inspectable without losing continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating one frontal beauty frame hides whether the media behave differently.

invariants.rule: Resolve the final message state in a new terminal medium and hold it without returning to the opening state.
invariants.purpose: Gives the informational relay an irreversible finish.
invariants.ablation_failure: A loop back to the first treatment or an unheld slogan collapses the forward progression.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source pale-haired woman, black eye graphic, plaid outfit and magenta-black fashion palette
the source LIGHT YOUR OWN WAY, TYPETURE, generated CHANGE FORUMLA-like and DREAM YOUR DIRECTION-like phrases
the source BREAK THE, MAKE IT YOURS, OPEN YOUR THE NEXT CHAPTER, EDIT STORY and CHOOSE YOUR LIFE wording
the source giant keyboard terrain, cloud lettering, domino-like slab circle, bubbles, zipper, editing interface and eye close-up
the source exact performer-led text-medium order and final neon title-card treatment

instantiations.concept: An original cobalt inspection rover advances SCAN to TRACE to NORTH to VERIFIED through an arctic mapping lab: a floor light-grid establishes SCAN, a punched paper strip produces TRACE, ferrofluid raises NORTH into relief, frost etches VERIFIED across a glass survey plate and the rover stops beside the held terminal result.

instantiations.concept: In tactile stop-motion ceramics, a kiln cart advances MARK to PRESS to FIRE to MENDED from chalk guide, clay stamp blocks, woven heat tape and glaze-crackle reflection into a finished fired tile; every station uses a new camera proof and the cart remains traceable to the held terminal result.
